definitions.gloss: more than enough; ample; exceeding full capacity
definitions.explanation: Going beyond what is sufficient or expected. Literally 'twelve parts out of ten' — exceeding 100 percent. Used to emphasize that something is more than adequate.

examples.japanese: {十二分|じゅうにぶん}に{楽|たの}しめた。
examples.english: I enjoyed it more than enough.

examples.japanese: {準備|じゅんび}は{十二分|じゅうにぶん}にできている。
examples.english: The preparations are more than adequate.

examples.japanese: この{選手|せんしゅ}は{十二分|じゅうにぶん}な{実力|じつりょく}を{持|も}っているので、{優勝|ゆうしょう}の{可能性|かのうせい}は{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This athlete has more than enough ability, so the chances of winning are high.

notes:
An intensified form of {十分|じゅうぶん} (sufficient, enough). While {十分|じゅうぶん} means "fully sufficient" (10 out of 10), {十二分|じゅうにぶん} goes beyond that — "120 percent."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十二分|じゅうにぶん}に{発揮|はっき}する: to demonstrate to the fullest (and beyond)
- {十二分|じゅうにぶん}な{成果|せいか}: more-than-sufficient results
- {十二分|じゅうにぶん}に{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy thoroughly
- {十二分|じゅうにぶん}に{活用|かつよう}する: to make full use of

USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the adverbial form {十二分|じゅうにぶん}に. More emphatic than {十分|じゅうぶん} but less colloquial than expressions like {十分|じゅうぶん}すぎる.

RELATED WORDS:
- {十分|じゅうぶん}: sufficient, enough — the base form that this word intensifies
